title: Agile Optimized
description: Stripped down and smooth, built to run fast without the bloat.
body:
**Peak FPS Only**

Agile Optimized doesn't mess around. It's built for one thing: absolute maximum frames. We finely tuned the pack by removing conflicting and redundant culling mods, leaving only a perfectly synchronized engine of core powerhouses like Sodium, Lithium, and ImmediatelyFast. This ensures your game runs buttery smooth with zero lag and maximum stability, even on a potato PC.

![Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ebf1c679e355f9ff86ca51b30ed158b9a490166a_0.webp)

**Pure Vanilla Feel**

This pack is dedicated to keeping Minecraft looking exactly the way Mojang intended. We stripped away intrusive texture tweaks like modified grass borders, path depth, and custom mount HUDs to give you a true, uncompromised vanilla visual experience. You get the classic look you love, just running at blindingly fast speeds.

**OptiFine Feature Parity**

No need to give up your favorite visual features. This pack retains full OptiFine parity, meaning support for shaders, custom entity models, and zoom work right out of the box. If your favorite resource pack requires OptiFine features, it will run flawlessly here without altering your core game textures.

**Server Compatible**

Agile Optimized has zero content-changing mods, so you won't get banned or blocked anywhere. You can hop onto any vanilla server, SMP, or competitive minigame network instantly. Plus, it works smoothly across all major game launchers.

**Built for the Latest Versions**

True to its name, this pack is optimized to run flawlessly on the newest Minecraft releases. We keep the mod list lightweight and clean, avoiding bloated or outdated dependencies so you can jump into the latest game updates with peak performance on day one.

**Fabric Powered**

We built this on the Fabric loader because it's super lightweight and doesn't hog your system resources. It keeps the game running incredibly lean, making it the perfect, stable base for the ultimate smooth gameplay experience.
